video_title: Washburn: Jaylen Brown Situation is a BLEMISH on Brad Stevens Reputation

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Gary Washburn criticizes Brad Stevens' handling of Jaylen Brown trade talks
quotes.excerpt: I think this is a major blemish on Brad Stevens' resume of how this has been handled.
quotes.quote: I think this is a major blemish on Brad Stevens' resume of how this has been handled. You don't, if you're going to go after a star player, you're going to go after a Giannis Antetokounmpo, you don't offer your star player and then not get him. And then you have to bring the star player back and let him know that he was literally ready to be sent off and that if your team had its choice, he wouldn't be here. So, I think this has been terribly handled by the Celtics and Brad Stevens.

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics' trade talks for Jaylen Brown hurt their future leverage
quotes.excerpt: Now that you've let the league know that you're willing to part with Jaylen Brown, do you really think you're going to get good return?
quotes.quote: Now that you've let the league know that you're willing to part with Jaylen Brown, do you really think you're going to get good return on your dollar for Jaylen Brown? No. Other teams know that you're trying to move him, so why would they give you an attractive package? You've got to figure out if you're the Celtics, one, do we want Jaylen Brown here long term? And two, do we just want to trade Jaylen Brown for anything to get this over with?

quotes.speaker: A. Sherrod Blakely
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's Hall of Fame trajectory makes him a bad trade candidate
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown is going to be in the Hall of Fame. Five-time All-Star, NBA Finals MVP, multiple All-NBA honors.
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown is going to be in the Hall of Fame. Five-time All-Star, NBA Finals MVP, multiple All-NBA honors, before he's 30. He hasn't even hit the 30 mark yet and he's accomplished all this. He's going to be in the Hall of Fame. When you have a player with that resume who isn't what we would consider a basketball cancer to the team, which Jaylen Brown is not, why so aggressively trying to get rid of him?

quotes.speaker: A. Sherrod Blakely
quotes.summary_phrase: The Celtics should have taken Jaylen Brown off the trade table
quotes.excerpt: The best way to save face in all this was to just basically take him off the table.
quotes.quote: To me, if you're the Celtics, the best way to save face in all this was to just basically take him off the table. To just say that we're not looking to trade him now. We had an opportunity to get a once-in-a-lifetime type player in Giannis Antetokounmpo, two-time MVP, all that. That didn't work out. That would be the only caliber of player that we'd seriously consider moving him for. But now, you've doubled down on making him available.

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Brad Stevens needs to clarify the Jaylen Brown trade rumors
quotes.excerpt: Listen Jaylen, we weren't trying to dangle you. Were we getting calls about you? Yes.
quotes.quote: The way Stevens can handle it with Jaylen is saying, 'Listen Jaylen, we weren't trying to dangle you. Were we getting calls about you? Yes. Did we dangle you out there? No.' So, you can make, you can frame it that way and maybe Jaylen goes, 'Okay.' But I don't understand this. I really don't. The Giannis thing, okay, but now to just go, 'Okay, well we just going to move him now.' What kind of negotiating power does that put you in? None.

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's value to the Warriors is unique and hard to replicate
quotes.excerpt: Draymond Green, valuable player for the Golden State Warriors. It would be interesting to see if the Warriors try to move him.
quotes.quote: Draymond Green, valuable player for the Golden State Warriors. It would be interesting to see if the Warriors try to move him, because what he does for Golden State might not impact or translate to other teams. I'm not saying Jaylen wouldn't translate, but what he does in Boston, when he's given to Boston, is special. Working with Jayson Tatum, being Jayson Tatum's partner, all that is unique.
